enemies.name: Military Hound
enemies.flavour_text: Military hounds that first saw action in Bolívar. Their claws and fangs are as vicious as their temperament.

enemies.name: Elite Military Hound
enemies.flavour_text: Carefully picked military hounds that chase their quarry to the bitter end.

enemies.name: Trimounts City Defender
enemies.flavour_text: Columbian soldiers stationed in Trimounts. They have close ties to all the tech companies and first dibs on cutting-edge equipment.

abilities.text: Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

enemies.name: Trimounts City Defender Captain
enemies.flavour_text: Columbian soldiers stationed in Trimounts. They have a good understanding of all the tech companies and will choose to fight with their favorite corporation's equipment.

abilities.text: Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

enemies.name: Arc Commando
enemies.flavour_text: Soldiers from the experimental unit born of the 'Horizon Arc Project,' able to fly at low altitudes with their jet propulsion equipment.

abilities.text: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!

enemies.name: Arc Commando Captain
enemies.flavour_text: Soldiers from the experimental unit born of the 'Horizon Arc Project,' skilled at flying with their jet propulsion equipment. They enjoy the feeling of defying gravity.

abilities.text: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!

enemies.name: Arc Frontliner
enemies.flavour_text: Deadly soldiers from an experimental unit outfitted with cutting-edge equipment. However, the instability of their gear is their weak spot.

abilities.text: Loses HP proportional to distance moved when shifted

enemies.name: Arc Frontliner Leader
enemies.flavour_text: Deadly soldiers from an experimental unit outfitted with highly lethal cutting-edge equipment. A formidable foe even when their gear's weaknesses have been revealed.

abilities.text: Loses HP proportional to distance moved when shifted

enemies.name: Arc Screenguard
enemies.flavour_text: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. However, the unresolved instability of the material makes them better suited for short, high-pressure skirmishes than drawn-out battles.

abilities.text: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

enemies.name: Arc Screenguard Captain
enemies.flavour_text: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. They don't even need their equipment to hold the frontline and prevent the enemy's advance.

abilities.text: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

enemies.name: 'Offender' Production Model
enemies.flavour_text: Unmanned attack vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. Equipped with advanced power units, they assault the enemy with their solid defenses and high speed.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When passing by an Operator, deals physical damage to them based on Movement Speed

enemies.name: 'Offender' Prototype
enemies.flavour_text: Unmanned attack vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. Equipped with advanced power units, they fiercely assault the enemy with their solid defenses and high speed.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When passing by an Operator, deals physical damage to them based on Movement Speed

enemies.name: 'Crossroads' Production Model
enemies.flavour_text: Unmanned defense vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. They emit mid-length lasers in all four directions, providing excellent defense in narrow corridors, and significantly hindering the enemy even in open terrain.

abilities.text: Attacks in 4 directions while moving, dealing Arts damage and deals increased damage to nearby targets
Continuously tries to push nearby <Planetary Debris>

enemies.name: 'Crossroads' Prototype
enemies.flavour_text: Unmanned defense vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. They emit intense mid-length lasers in all four directions, providing first-class defense in narrow corridors, and dramatically hindering the enemy even in open terrain.

abilities.text: Attacks in 4 directions while moving, dealing Arts damage and deals increased damage to nearby targets
Continuously tries to push nearby <Planetary Debris>

enemies.name: 'Traffic Tower' Production Model
enemies.flavour_text: A robot primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski, the crystallization of cutting-edge advances in every field. Volvort Kochinski wanted to use this design to win back the DOD's favor, but it was overshadowed by the Galleria Stellaria.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
DEF and RES is reduced whenever damage is taken
When destroyed, ejects a <'Traffic Officer'> and self-destructs, dealing physical damage to nearby units

enemies.name: 'Traffic Tower' Prototype
enemies.flavour_text: A robot primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski, the crystallization of cutting-edge advances in every field. If they could lower the cost of production to make it feasible for mass-production, perhaps it could even change the nature of warfare.

abilities.text: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
DEF and RES is reduced whenever damage is taken
When destroyed, ejects a <'Traffic Officer Captain'> and self-destructs, dealing physical damage to nearby units

enemies.name: 'Traffic Officer'
enemies.flavour_text: Pilot of a 'Traffic Tower,' the cream of the crop from the military's strict selection process. Has impressive combat abilities even after leaving their robot.

abilities.text: Starts temporarily invisible and accelerates
Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

enemies.name: 'Traffic Officer Captain'
enemies.flavour_text: Pilot of a 'Traffic Tower,' the cream of the crop from the military's strict selection process. Has formidable combat abilities even after leaving their robot. They are even trained to detonate their vehicle in emergencies and continue the fight on foot.

abilities.text: Starts temporarily invisible and accelerates
Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

enemies.name: Kristen
enemies.flavour_text:
Egotist. Betrayer. Seeker. Loner. Pioneer.
Goodnight, Terra.

abilities.text: Every 'Star Ring' grants <Kristen> +1 Block and reduces damage received
First Form
Immune to control effects and takes reduced damage from 'Planetary Debris'
Periodically overrides 'Planetary Debris' and turns them into 'Star Rings' (Allies in the surrounding 8 tiles take Arts damage and have reduced ASPD)
[Heat Death] When HP reaches 0, detonates every 'Star Ring' on the field, dealing Arts damage to all friendly units on the field
Second Form
When entering Second Form, immediately overrides all 'Planetary Debris'
Gains increased ATK, and attacks an additional target
Will no longer override 'Planetary Debris,' but destroying a 'Star Ring' deals Arts damage to all allies on the field and increases all enemies' Movement Speed
[Heat Death] When HP reaches 0 for the first time, detonates every 'Star Ring' on the field, dealing a large amount of Arts damage to all friendly units on the field
